*New options:
**"[[Assimilated Enderman]] Ally Teleport Cooldown" - "Cooldown in ticks for teleporting allies." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"Assimilated Enderman First Sighting Teleport Cooldown" - "Cooldown in ticks to start teleporting when engaging an enemy." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[Corrosion|Corrosive]] Percentage To Work" - "If the durability of the armor is below this threshold, the effect will not work." - SRParasitesSystems.cfg
**"[[Stage I Dispatcher]] Effect List" - "List of potion effects that the Stage I Dispatcher will apply to relocated parasites." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[[Stage II Dispatcher]] Effect List" - "List of potion effects that the Stage II Dispatcher will apply to relocated paraites." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[Stage III Dispatcher]] Effect List" - "List of potion effects that the Stage III Dispatcher will apply to relocated parasites." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[Stage IV Dispatcher]] Effect List" - "List of potion effects that the Stage IV Dispatcher will apply to relocated parasites." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"Assimilated Enderman Ally Teleport Damage" - "Damage to teleported allies." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] See Through Walls" - "Set to true if you want the view check to be performed when searching for enemies." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] See Through Walls" - "Set to true if you want the view check to be performed when searching for enemies." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure]] See Through Walls" - "Set to true if you want the view check to be performed when searching for enemies." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]] See Through Walls" - "Set to true if you want the view check to be performed when searching for enemies." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Block Sound Play" - "Chance to play (1=100%) block sound when broken by parasites." - SRParasites.cfg
**"[[Living Armor]] Point Chance to Learn" - "Chance to adapt (1=100%) to the damage." - SRParasites.cfg
**"[[Sentient Armor]] Point Chance to Learn" - "Chance to adapt (1=100%) to the damage." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Armor Damage Types BlackList" - "Damage that cannot be learned by the armor." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Armor Damage Types BlackList Inverted" - "Set to true if you want to use the list as a WhiteList." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Block Drops Spawn" - "Chance to spawn (1=100%) block drops when broken by parasites." - SRParasites.cfg
**"[[Orb]] Attacking" - "Set to false if you dont want the parasites to spawn orbs." - SRParasites.cfg
**"[[Colony]] Parasite Values" - "List of parasites that require Colony points to appear, parasites that are not in the list will not be affected." - SRParasitesWorld.cfg
**"Armor COTH" - "Set to true for the armor to apply [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]] to the user." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Phase Total Slaughter" - "From this [[Evolution Phases|phase]] on, parasites will kill everything (not ignoring config options)." - SRParasitesSystems.cfg
 
====<u>General changes</u>====
*New textures (Vinni) for the Living/Sentient Armor set
*New textures (Vinni) for [[:Category:Weapons|Living/Sentient Weapons]]
*[[Corrosion|Corrosive]] effect will no longer destroy armor
*Armor from this mod now has a chance to learn instead of always
*Changed texture for the feeler block face up
*Custom mob spawner and the parasite mob cap will only work if [[Evolution Phases]] is turned on
*Throwingball changes:
**It is now named [[Quench]]
**Range changed from 3 to 7
**Added cooldown of 1 sec
**Added recipe
*Every random tick, the [[Parasite Biome#Biome Purifier|Purifier]] Block will:
**Scan an area (32 blocks radius) and apply the Glowing effect to every [[:Category:Nexus Parasites|nexus]] version inside
**Will clean [[Beckon (Disambiguation)|infestation]] (5 blocks radius) by starting a chain reaction
*Updated the following lang files:
**ro_ro
**ru_ru
**zh_cn
 
====<u>Mobs</u>====
*Dispatcher tentacles will not remove Evolution Points when killed
*[[Dispatcher (Disambiguation)|Dispatchers]] will no apply effects to relocated parasites 
*Dispatcher Tentacles spawn mobs 1 second faster
*Teleported parasites by the [[Assimilated Enderman]] will now take damage (following ender pearl logic, value reduced)
*Assimilated Enderman will now play the teleport sound effect when finding a player
*Reduced [[Succor]] xp value
*If Assimilated Enderman is on fire there is a 75% chance for teleported mobs to be set on fire
*Changed texture for the [[Primitive Arachnida]] and its variants
*Changed texture for the [[Buglin]]
*Changed texture for the [[Thrall]]
*Succor spawning from [[:Category:Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]] will now spawn biomass particles
*Tweaked Succor flying logic
*If [[Beckon (Disambiguation)|Beckon]] or [[Primitive Summoner|Primitive]]/[[Adapted Summoner]] is on fire then biomass will be set on Fire and parasite spawned from biomass will be set on fire plus health will be multiplied by 0.5
*Biomass passive regeneration added
*Decreased dispatcher tentacle spawnrate from dispatchers and tweaked attack logic (WIP,in progress)
*Tweaked minimum charge attack distance for:
**[[Warden]]
**[[Primitive Reeker|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Reeker]]
**[[Assimilated Cow|Cow]]
*[[:Category:Deterrent Parasites|Deterrent]] and [[:Category:Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] type parasites will die slowly if [[Evolution Phases]] are on and the [[Reinforcement System|RS]] chance of the current phase is 0
**In addition, Beckons/Dispatchers will convert connected blocks of their current position
*Added new sound effects for:
**[[Assimilated Wolf]]
**[[Bogle]]/[[Wraith]]
**[[Adapted Longarms]]

*Dispatcher changes:
**1 tentacle will only spawn 1 parasite
**Will not unhide mobs that are on water
**Will follow rule of the [[Host]]/[[Herd]] teleportation to store/spawn tentacles
**If a parasite was previously stored then if it despawns it will be returned to the Dispatcher (if available)
**Number of tentacles it can spawn: current stage * 3
**It will not target multiple mobs if total number of mobs > number of parasites stored

*Added same dash to: 
**[[Mangler]]
**[[Monarch]]
**[[Warden]]
**[[Marauder]]
**[[Grunt]]
**[[Haunter]]

*Added teleportation cooldown for [[Assimilated Enderman]] when finding an enemy
**This cooldown is negated when it receives damage
**Also applies to the teleportation of allies
**There is also a second cooldown for ally teleportation
